reel.facebook: NAP stands for Name, Address, and Phone number. NAP consistency means those three pieces of information are identical on every platform where your business appears. Google uses citations to verify you are a real, located business. When your data conflicts across platforms, Google loses confidence in your location and shows you less. 73 percent of consumers lose trust in a business when they find conflicting information online, according to BrightLocal. The fix is simple: pick one format and use it everywhere. Start by auditing Google, Apple Maps, Bing Places, Yelp, and Facebook. Full guide at the link.
